path_step: User submits a registered email for password reset and expects an on-screen notification.
test_scenario: Verify that the system provides an on-screen notification to the user after successfully submitting their email for password reset, instructing them to check their inbox.
test_case_title: Verify 'Check Inbox' notification for password reset
pre_condition: User is on the 'Forgot Password' email submission form within the Login Modal.
expected_result: An on-screen message appears, informing the user that a password recovery email has been sent to their registered address and to check their inbox.
post_condition: User remains on the Login Modal, possibly with the email form closed or replaced by the notification.

test_steps.step: Enter a valid, registered email address into the email input field.
Verify the on-screen notification 'Check your inbox for password recovery link' is displayed.

uncovered_conditions: On-screen notification after recovery email sent
